primitives.name: Unity CLI
primitives.install: Windows PowerShell: $env:UNITY_CLI_VERSION='1.0.0'; irm https://public-cdn.cloud.unity3d.com/hub/prod/cli/install.ps1 | iex   macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://public-cdn.cloud.unity3d.com/hub/prod/cli/install.sh | UNITY_CLI_VERSION=1.0.0 bash
primitives.license_note: Free, separate from Unity AI per the docs; license text TODO(verify: CLI docs state no license, only the Documentation Terms of Use)

primitives.name: Unity Pipeline package (com.unity.pipeline)
primitives.install: unity pipeline install   (run from the project root; Unity 6.0 LTS or later)
primitives.license_note: TODO(verify: no license text on the Unity CLI docs pages)

primitives.name: Unity MCP (built into the Unity CLI)
primitives.install: unity mcp configure claude-code   (list clients: unity mcp configure --list)
primitives.license_note: Ships inside the Unity CLI binary. Replaces the deprecated MCP server in com.unity.ai.assistant

primitives.name: Unity agent plugin (official skill pack)
primitives.install: /plugin marketplace add Unity-Technologies/unity-agent-plugin  then  /plugin install unity@unity-agent-plugin

primitives.name: MCP for Unity (community, CoplayDev)
primitives.install: Package Manager > Add package from git URL: https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp.git?path=/MCPForUnity#v10.3.0

primitives.name: Unity Test Framework (com.unity.test-framework)
primitives.install: Ships with the Editor; confirm it is listed in Packages/manifest.json, or add it in Package Manager by name
